name: NihongoHub
purpose: Help non-Japanese speakers learn Japanese and navigate traveling to or living in Japan.
contentPolicy: Editorial content is AI-assisted and fact-checked against the public sources cited within each dataset item. Numeric claims carry a source and a confidence level; unverified items are labeled as such rather than asserted.

tools.name: Where Next? — Japan day-trip finder by time budget
tools.description: Pick a base (Tokyo/Kyoto/Osaka) and a time budget; see which prefectures are reachable, with approximate rail times and food/culture highlights. Free, no signup.

tools.name: Japan Relocation Timeline Planner
tools.description: Enter a COE application date and see a realistic, source-attributed relocation timeline (COE processing, visa, entry window, residence registration, bank barriers). Free, no signup.

tools.name: International Transfer Cost Estimator
tools.description: Illustrative cost comparison by channel anchored on World Bank Remittance Prices Worldwide averages. Informational only. Free, no signup.

monetizationDisclosure: Some outbound links to third-party services (e.g. travel booking, money transfer, travel insurance) are affiliate links. Recommendations are based on the cited factual merits of each service for the reader, not on commission.
